pages.title: Distilled or Filled
pages.text: A urine compooper distills into a water compooper. Empty compoopers can also collect rain or be filled with a water bucket.$(br2)Use a bucket to take the water out.

pages.title: Making Cobblestone
pages.text: Pour water beside lava to create cobblestone.$(br2)Cobblestone is a basic material for later toilets, tools, and infrastructure.
